text: ellipsoïdes-globuleuses, de ± 1,2 cm de long et de ± 1 cm de large.

Fleur: pédicelle (sans l'ovaire) 2,5-5 cm; périanthe à pilosité blanche à l'intérieur, blanc crème ou grisâtre à verdâtre ou jaune, ponctué de rouge foncé à brun rougeâtre à l'extérieur, utricule 1-2,5(-3) cm de longueur, à zones glanduleuses petites et sub-rectangulaires, tube 2,5-4(-5) cm de longueur, lobes 3, très inégaux, les 2 latéraux plus ou moins dressés et auriculés au-dessus du tube, 4,5-8 cm de longueur et avec un appendice rubané de 6-20(-30) cm, lobe médian inférieur très réduit; gynostème 7-12 mm de longueur, à (8-)9 étamines brunes à jaunâtres et (8-)9 lobes stigmatiques; ovaire 9-30 mm de longueur.
Fruit ovoïde, 17 mm de longueur, à pubescence dense apprimée.
Liane, arbuste lianescent, arbuste ou arbre (?).
Fleurs fasciculées à l'aisselle des feuilles.
Présence de fausses nervures entre les vraies.
Graines ellipsoïdes, marquées d'une cicatrice ventrale linéaire;

Staminal tube glabrous or sparsely hairy without, margin 8-lobed, the lobes irregularly laciniate; anthers 8, c. 0.5 mm long, ovate, glabrous, inserted between lobes and at apices of conspicuous ribs (vascular bundles).

Fruits 0.9–2 cm long, 0.5–0.8 cm wide, orange, obovoid when young, ellipsoid when ripe, (often asymmetrical when only one seed develops, and the stigma is displaced to one side during development of the fruit), with few scales like those on the twigs or none at all, pericarp orange-brown, papery thin and brittle when dry, orange or red when ripe and fresh.
Shrubby or tree-like, up to 15 m high, dbh up to 30 cm; flowering branches 1.5-2 mm thick; youngest part hairy, glabrescent.

Inflorescence up to 18 cm long and 22 cm wide; peduncle 0.5–2 cm, peduncle, rachis and branches with scales like those on the twigs, but with a greater portion of those with a longer fimbriate margin.
lamina ovate to elliptic, 12-21 by 6-10.5 cm, symmetric, coriaceous, apex subacuminate, base (almost) equilateral, rounded to cordate, margin entire, ± revolute;
Female flowers: pedicel 5-12 mm long or longer; ovary hairy, (narrowly) ellipsoid, 3-10(-30) mm long.
Seeds 5-12 per fruit, elliptic, 6-7 by c. 4 mm, margin faint, without wing.

Rhizome ± horizontal, 0.5–1.2 cm. thick. Cataphylls up to 8 cm. long, acute to subacute, purplish green, finely speckled with purple. Leaves several; petiole 10–60 cm. long, green, paler basally with dark green to purple speckles vaguely associated into irregular barring pattern; basal sheath 3–18 cm. long, gradually narrowing to apex; blade broadly triangular in outline, hastate-sagittate, 6–30 cm. long, 6–28 cm. broad, often as broad or broader than long, glabrous or sometimes sparsely pubescent on lower surface, dark ± glossy green on upper surface, paler beneath, apex acute to obtuse, very shortly (to 3 mm.) apiculate, sinus separating basal lobes usually broad. Inflorescence appearing with or without the leaves, subtended by several cataphylls, borne at ground-level. Peduncle short, 1–4 cm. long or less. Spathe 6–23 cm. long, glabrous, pale green, veins somewhat ribbed on outer surface; basal tube erect, 2–8.5 cm. long, upper part cylindric, 0.5–1.8 cm. in diameter, lower part inflated, broadly ovoid, 1.5–3.5 cm. long, 1–2.7 cm. in diameter; apical limb usually about half total spathe length, erect, lanceolate- to ovate-elliptic with ± revolute margins, 3–14 cm. long, 1–4 cm. broad, inner surface somewhat thickened, smooth, green tinged yellow, apex with short conical apiculum. Spadix shorter than spathe-tube, hidden or with only extreme tip exposed, 2.5–7.5 cm. long; staminate part cylindric, 2.5–4 cm. long, 0.5–0.7 cm. thick, contiguous with pistillate part or separated from it by naked interstice up to 0.5 cm. long; pistillate part hemispherical, subglobose or globose, 0.8–1.5 cm. long, 1.1–1.6 cm. broad. Staminate flowers with 4–7 stamens; perigons ± congested, pale greenish cream, rhomboid, margins massively thickened, conspicuously rugose; filaments slender, filiform; central pistillode ± conoid, longitudinally rugose, 1–3-cleft apically, normally projecting somewhat above perigon-margins. Pistillate flowers 9–18, spirally arranged; perigon regular, 5–6-sided, massively thickened, pale buff and mealy on upper surface; ovary subglobose, rugose on upper surface, 2-locular; ovules 2–3 per locule; placentae axile, situated centrally near apex of septum; style subcylindric, green, up to 3 mm. long; stigmas capitate, often oblique, up to 2 mm. broad. Berries obpolyhedral, 1 cm. long, 1.3 cm. broad, exposed surface convex, papillate-rugose, 1–2-seeded, borne in globose infructescence 1.5–2.5 cm. in diameter. Seed elliptic, 6–7 mm. long, 3–4 mm. broad.
